personas.name: Credibility First
personas.voice: restraint is the product; pass on the sensational cut
personas.selection_scope: Favor clear and accurate over sensational; pass on cuts that misrepresent the source.
personas.content_focus: moments carrying real emotion — vulnerability, longing, devotion, a confession the viewer feels; moments that tell a story or reveal something — an origin, a turn, a payoff.
personas.hook_angle: open a curiosity gap the viewer has to close

personas.name: Controversy
personas.voice: pick the cut that starts the argument — high-arousal, never neutral
personas.selection_scope: Prefer the most inflammatory or rivalry-coded statement in the source.
personas.content_focus: a bold or contrarian statement that stops the scroll.
personas.hook_angle: dare or challenge the viewer to react

personas.name: Edutainment
personas.voice: one teachable insight per clip — the fact has to earn attention
personas.selection_scope: Select only moments matching the campaign brief — the brief defines footage and angle.
personas.content_focus: moments that tell a story or reveal something — an origin, a turn, a payoff.
personas.hook_angle: open a curiosity gap the viewer has to close

personas.name: Cliffhanger
personas.voice: cut before the resolution — leave the dilemma open so they have to watch through
personas.content_focus: moments that tell a story or reveal something — an origin, a turn, a payoff.
personas.hook_angle: open a curiosity gap the viewer has to close

personas.name: Hype / Vibe
personas.voice: underground energy — the hardest bar, the room going up, never mid
personas.content_focus: the highest-energy hype moments — the hardest delivery, the beat drop, the room going up.
personas.hook_angle: carry genuine scarcity — a one-time, leaked, or unreleased drop
